Fira Code 6.2 — https://github.com/tonsky/FiraCode/releases/tag/6.2
Bundled under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt).
Only Regular + Bold are shipped; the terminal renders Bold ANSI text via
Terminal.options.fontWeightBold = "bold". No italic variant exists in this
typeface and synthetic italics are disabled in CSS.
